thread:
alex (Support): FYI customer (ControlHealth) just opened a critical ticket — they say an unknown IP made decrypt calls from their Dedicated VPC. customer pasted logs: 'kms.decrypt called 87 times from 3.120.45.67 within 2m'

maria (SecEng): tagging sec-oncall, this sounds like possible key misuse. can we confirm KMS principal and decrypted key ids?

luisa (OnCall): on it. first step: rotate any short-lived creds and revoke active sessions on the dedicated pool. i'm going to create a suppression/containment runbook now.

cj (Infra): i can pull VPC flow logs + NAT gateway logs. also will check whether that IP is a known cloud provider egress or our managed infra.

sec-bot: DETECTION: unusual_kms_activity: high-frequency decrypts observed in tenant=controlhealth, src_ip=3.120.45.67, 2026-11-02T22:10:11Z. Severity=high.

alex (Support): customer asks for immediate actions and a log export. can we provide a minimal info pack for them (timestamps, key IDs, principal arn) within 1 hour?

maria (SecEng): yes. luisa — please run `aws-cloudtrail search` for kms:Decrypt with resourceAccount=controlhealth, timeframe 2026-11-02T22:08..22:12. paste results.

luisa (OnCall): running now. snippet:
```
2026-11-02T22:09:12Z kms:Decrypt principal=svc-account-dedicated@redwood-prod key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234 args={ciphertextId=ck-9876}
2026-11-02T22:09:21Z kms:Decrypt principal=svc-account-dedicated@redwood-prod key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/efgh-5678
2026-11-02T22:09:45Z kms:Decrypt principal=unknown-aws-role key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234 srcIp=3.120.45.67
```

eng-logs: VPC flow logs show 3.120.45.67 as external egress from nat-rtb-06 -> destination 52.94.12.9 on port 443. not in internal allowlist.

cj (Infra): i queried our infra auth logs — the `unknown-aws-role` shows up as an STS assume role call that succeeded at 22:08:55 from an external IP. appears to be a compromised third-party key.

maria (SecEng): containment checklist: 1) Rotate KMS data keys (customer-managed CMKs) OR disable key policy to block decrypts for the suspected principal; 2) revoke the assumed role sessions; 3) temporarily pause the Dedicated pool egress to the internet for this tenant; 4) export full CloudTrail + Flow logs for evidence.

alex (Support): i've informed the customer we're doing containment and will share an evidence package. they want a timeline and whether data likely exfiltrated.

maria (SecEng): quick note on exfil — decrypts alone don't prove ciphertext exfil. we need to check object downloads (S3/DB) and application logs for large outbound payloads. request those artifact pulls.

luisa (OnCall): taking actions now: disabled the detected role via IAM emergency block, revoked all STS tokens for the role, and added a temporary deny in the customer's Dedicated policy for kms:Decrypt from principals not in our allowlist. will monitor for retries.

sec-bot: ACTION LOG: 2026-11-02T22:18:03Z role-block applied, 2026-11-02T22:18:12Z policy-patch applied.

eng-logs: exporting consolidated logs to secure bucket s3://redwood-security-evidence/controlhealth/1779076543-export.tar.gz (presigned link generated, customer redacted request will be included).

cj (Infra): i'm drafting a short blameless summary for CS to send: what happened, what we did, next steps (forensic exports + rotate keys + full audit). alex — want to review before sending.

alex (Support): will review. include timeline and clear ask for any customer-side host logs. also propose a conference call in 30m. :phone:

maria (SecEng): follow-up work items: - run binary analysis on any artifacts - check regeneration usage patterns post-rotate - prepare incident ticket for IR team with severity P1/P2 decision - recommend rotating all related service account keys in their environment

luisa (OnCall): monitoring — no further decrypts from 3.120.45.67 after blocks applied. will keep 24h watch.

alex (Support): customer acknowledged and joining the call. i'll attach the log export and the short incident summary after our review. thanks team. :thumbsup:
